| Warning: llama-perplexity cannot rank quant formats on hybrid-GDN models | 1× Intel Arc Pro B70 | Official lab | On Qwen3.8-27B (qwen3_5: 48 GDN + 16 full-attention layers), wikitext-2 PPL came back NON-monotonic in precision: Q4_K_M 6.547 < mixed 6.653 < Q8_0 6.678 < Q5_K_M 6.794. Root cause: the full-F16 reference scored 6.5545 - worse than Q4_K_M on 7/8 chunks and ~= Q8_0 - so the metric (recurrent-state accumulation), not the weights, is confounded; quant kernels exonerated. PPL also grows with chunk length (6.29 -> 7.15 at c2048 -> c8192). Upstream: ggml-org/llama.cpp#28879. Use per-position logit parity vs F16 for quality on linear-attention hybrids. | [source](https://github.com/SergiioB/intel-arc-pro-b70-inference-cookbook/blob/22bd3253ae908112a5681a63f7f2ddf20066948d/docs/qwen38-27b/QUANT-FORMAT-SHOWDOWN-B70.md) |

| Qwen3.8-27B EXL3 route (one B70): correctness, 262144 context, prefix cache | 1× Intel Arc Pro B70 | Official lab | Primary single-card Qwen3.8-27B route since the 2026-09-26/27 re-measure campaign (CAM-2026-AUTOROUND-VS-EXL3). Correctness: 6/6 exact-answer battery incl. code_execution 14/14 twice and clean replay - the only quantized arm to pass alongside OpenVINO int4. Context: the only arm at the native 262,144 boundary on one card - real 261,920-token prompt completed with correct needle retrieval (fp8 KV pool 287,040 tok @gmu 0.94; cold 258,480-tok prompt 389 s ~664 tok/s prefill; cached re-run 13-28 s). Host-executed task battery (cache ON): 8/10 on 5 bugfix + 5 codegen cases. Prefix cache: 10,546-token shared prefix 8.11 s cold -> ~1.5 s cached (5.4x, best of all arms). KV dtype is fp8-only (bf16 rejected by reshape_and_cache_flash). Effective decode bandwidth ~240-355 GB/s (150->230 W) - below OV int4's ~414 GB/s roofline band consistent with compute-bound trellis dequant on Xe2 (upstream hypothesis, unproven locally); EXL3 wins on correctness + capacity + footprint (15.7 GiB weights) instead. | [source](https://github.com/SergiioB/intel-arc-pro-b70-inference-cookbook/blob/55eefeaeaa1e47b9e34b2fd20f55ffc1a8125c6c/docs/qwen38-27b/EXL3-XPU.md) |
| Qwen3.8-27B EXL3 SC_5.00bpw_H6 route (one B70): mixed-K correctness + quality pick | 1× Intel Arc Pro B70 | Official lab | turboderp SC_5.00bpw_H6 (mixed trellis K=4..7) served on the exl3xpu-mixedk image (0xsero 0.1.0 + mixed-K patches, SergiioB/exllamav3 b70/ @244f57e5). Kernel level: 46/46 mixed-K checks pass (fp16+int8 linear paths K=4..7, M=1..512, fused-mixed qkv[5,7,7]). | Qwen3.8-27B EXL3 SC_5.00bpw_H6 served quality: int8 vs fp16 prefill (one B70) | 1× Intel Arc Pro B70 | Official lab | As-served quality of exl3xpu's default W8A8 int8 prefill (EXL3_INT8_PREFILL=1) vs fp16 prefill on SC5, same image (2026-10-14). Prompt logprobs top-128 through /v1/completions, MTP and prefix caching off (hit delta 0), fp8 KV, prefill chunk 1024. Decision panel: 18 turboderp held-out chat rows (qbench_prompts_gen, response positions only, 44,473 per pass), two passes per server load. Coarse KL lower bound (reference top-128 plus one tail bucket, tail mass 0.0007) fp16 -> int8: 0.00099 [0.00092, 0.00107] on both passes, top-1 agreement 98.93 %, delta NLL +0.00065 / +0.00115 nats. Noise floor fp16 pass 1 -> pass 2: 0.00004 (cross-load 0.00003); int8 pass 1 -> pass 2: 0.00081. Predeclared rule: valid (floor <= 0.1x effect); effect / SC5 weight-quant KL on held-out chat (0.00141, record qwen38-27-exl3xpu-sc5-kl-screen) = 0.70 (CI low 0.65) -> material. Isolated probes found every prefill op bitwise repeatable; the run-to-run drift is upstream input differences amplified about 2x by int8 rounding, so determinism would not remove the shift. A first four-arm run is retained as invalid by its own determinism rule (diagnostic only). Decode path unchanged (int8 runs only on prompt chunks above 128 tokens). Not covered: fp8 KV error, task-level quality, other artifacts. | [source](https://github.com/SergiioB/intel-arc-pro-b70-inference-cookbook/blob/1d67d61259ee62451ef797c6ca3b24abcc866ccd/results/qwen38-27b/sc5-int8-prefill-kl-20261014/README.md) |

## Trust labels

- **Official lab:** measured under the cookbook's documented process.
- **Community reviewed:** schema and evidence reviewed; contributor controls the machine.
- **Validated:** an operational capability worked; any model-specific numeric records are published separately.
- **Provisional:** an early numeric claim is documented but lacks one or more required workload coordinates.
